lens.headline: One brand. More than one performance story.
lens.interpretation: The sourced global platform centers on permission to pause. The monitored US uploads use Power Your Legacy and It Takes More. The question is how these expressions connect—not whether different lines alone prove a fragmented strategy.
lens.what_changed: A global recovery platform alongside US creative framed around legacy and competitive stakes.
lens.why_it_matters: Does the work make hydration, recovery and ambition feel like one coherent view of performance?
lens.implication: Track whether new US executions connect the product benefit to that worldview, rather than adding another disconnected line.
lens.limitations: Reduction editorial hypothesis based on the reviewed platform source and official upload titles, not a full creative-content analysis or a finding of campaign effectiveness.
